svg.text: Figure 7: Multi-Panel Scatter Grid — Top 6 Linguistic Features vs. Watermark Degradation
Each point is 1 document (N = 600), colored by Domain with OLS linear regression fit and Pearson correlation (r)
1. Vocabulary Size vs. Rel Z-Drop % (r = +0.363, p = 3.9e-20)
2. SMOG Readability vs. Rel Z-Drop % (r = +0.344, p = 4.0e-18)
3. Bigram Entropy vs. Rel Z-Drop % (r = +0.309, p = 1.0e-14)
6. Word Count vs. Initial Z-Score (r = +0.526, p = 5.7e-44)
